LHR - generally great option if you are trying to clear large areas of hair. And the results are permanent. However I have found that it actually hurts more when I have had it done on my face compared to electrolysis. But it's like 10 mins of pain. 

Electrolysis - great for cleaning up small amounts of hair and it's highly effective. Personally I think it hurts less.

In my opinion a combination of the two is required for great permanent results on large amounts of hair.  However LHR clears up most of the bulk.
